promotion_rule: Do not add any supplement-only candidate to the canonical 47-taxon universe until supplement or Figshare content directly confirms membership and the full 47-taxon reconciliation is reproducible.
next_gate: Ingest Supplemental Information 1 or 2, or the equivalent Figshare raw data, then reconcile the three missing taxa exactly before freezing the U1 double-code frame.
